# SmartGen Tools - LLM Context File

SmartGen is a modern, fast, and privacy-focused utility platform built for professionals, developers, and everyday users. It offers a wide range of free online tools for SEO, web development, content creation, and utility calculations.

## Key Features
- **Privacy First**: Most tools use 100% client-side processing, ensuring data never leaves the user's browser.
- **Performance Optimized**: Built for speed with a focus on Core Web Vitals (Zero CLS).
- **Comprehensive Toolset**: Over 130+ tools across various categories.
- **Open Source**: A community-driven project focused on accessibility.

## Tool Categories

### SEO Tools
- **SEO Audit Tool**: Score any website out of 100 across 27 free technical, E-E-A-T and trust-signal checks (72 in the premium report). Server-side crawl via the SmartGen Platforms API; 3 free audits per visitor per day, no signup.
- **Meta Tag Generator**: Create SEO-optimized meta tags for websites.
- **Schema Markup Generator**: Generate JSON-LD structured data for search engines.
- **Sitemap Finder & Downloader**: Discover and download XML sitemaps.
- **Keyword Density Checker**: Analyze content for keyword optimization.
- **SERP Snippet Preview**: Visualize how your page appears in search results.

### Developer Utilities
- **JSON Formatter & Validator**: Clean and validate JSON data.
- **Base64 to Image / Image to Base64**: Convert between formats instantly.
- **HTML Code Library**: A collection of 70+ visual-to-code snippets.
- **Hash Generator**: Create secure MD5, SHA-1, and SHA-256 hashes.
- **UUID Generator**: Generate unique identifiers for development.

### Content & Marketing
- **Blog Title Generator**: Create catchy titles for articles.
- **UTM Builder**: Generate campaign tracking links.
- **Fancy Font Generator**: Create stylized text for social media.
- **WhatsApp Link Generator**: Create direct chat links with custom messages.
- **Lorem Ipsum Generator**: Generate placeholder text for designs.

### General Utilities
- **Age Calculator**: Calculate exact age and date differences.
- **BMI & BMR Calculator**: Track health and fitness metrics.
- **EMI Calculator**: Plan finances with loan calculations.
- **Image Compressor**: Optimize images for web use without losing quality.
- **Unit Converter**: Convert between different measurement units.

## Technical Architecture
- **Frontend**: Vanilla HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript (ES6+).
- **Monetization**: Integrated with Adsterra with 100% CLS prevention.
- **Deployment**: Optimized for static hosting with automated build scripts for Blog and Docs.
- **SEO**: Dynamic canonical tags, automated sitemap generation, and optimized metadata.
